testcase.name: Scenario: Browse for a preview image and cancel the image chooser: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:66:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Browse for a preview image and cancel the image chooser ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+S to open Save As ✔ And the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And Save Preview Picture is selected ✔ When the user chooses Import From File as the preview source ✔ Then a browse control appears beside that option ✔ And the preview area displays a placeholder ✔ When the user chooses the browse control ✔ Then an image file chooser opens above the Save As dialog ✔ When the user cancels the image file chooser ✔ Then the Save As dialog remains open ✔ And Import From File remains selected ✔ And the preview area still displays a placeholder ✔ When the user chooses Active Component Iso View on Save ✔ And the user cancels Save As ✔ Then the unsaved part remains active
